_comment: Single source of truth for exercise definitions, loaded by BOTH runtimes:
Changing a threshold here changes it everywhere. Previously these numbers
were duplicated by hand in each runtime and had already drifted apart -
the web engine was measuring the shoulder joint while Python measured the
elbow, using identical thresholds for both.
Landmark indices are MediaPipe Pose indices.

bicep._angleComment: Elbow flexion: shoulder -> elbow -> wrist. Low = contracted.
bicep._thresholdComment: Crossed with +/- tolerances.angleDeg applied at check time.

_angleComment: Elbow extension: shoulder -> elbow -> wrist. High = locked out.
The web engine used to measure elbow -> shoulder -> hip here, a
different joint entirely, while applying these same thresholds.
shoulder._faultsComment: symmetryMidRange fires while still pressing; symmetry fires at lockout, where an imbalance is more serious.
